d: A ₹1,427.34-crore alleged sand mining scam is under investigation in Tamil Nadu, with former Water Resources Minister Durai Murugan among those named in a DVAC FIR. The probe covers 28 quarry sites, with detailed findings from four so far. Investigators allege that tenders were manipulated, sand was extracted beyond authorised limits and fake permits were used to conceal illegal transportation. The case also has a political timeline: the ED registered a case in 2024, the DMK government authorised a DVAC inquiry in 2025, and the FIR was registered under the TVK government in November 2026.…
